sentences.en: There are many hurdles to overcome when translating literary texts.
sentences.zh: 翻译：在翻译文学作品时，有很多障碍需要克服。

sentences.en: The biggest hurdle for pupils writing the exam was question fourteen.
sentences.zh: 翻译：学生们参加考试时最大的障碍是第十四题。

sentences.en: The first hurdles have been cleared, but they won't be the last.
sentences.zh: 翻译：第一个障碍已经克服了，但还会有更多的挑战。
